source_pdf: MIL-HDBK-217F_base_Quanterion.pdf (Quanterion copy of MIL-HDBK-217F, 2 December 1991; this section was not revised by Notice 1 or Notice 2, so the base pages are the Notice 2 pages)
model: Fixed failure rates as listed (failures/10^6 hours); entries marked times_pi_E are multiplied by the pi_E table named in the entry
notes: Page 23-1 also lists microwave attenuators (fixed and variable) as See Resistors, Type RD, and fixed microwave elements (directional couplers, fixed stubs and cavities) as Negligible; neither has a numeric rate in this section. The handbook cautions that excessive mating and demating cycles may seriously degrade reliability of the connector entries. Section 23 was not revised by Notice 2, so these are the base handbook pages 23-1 and 23-2 as retained in the Notice 2 handbook. In the task section list this category was called 22.x; in the handbook as published it is Section 23. Because most entries are fixed rates rather than a lambda_b product model, the generic part_failure_rate function does not evaluate this file.
